newsitem.title: UK: Med oil products mixed - gas oil firms on good demand.
newsitem.headline: Med oil products mixed - gas oil firms on good demand.

text.p: Mediterranean oil products were mixed on Tuesday, traders said.
Gas oil prices were slightly firmer, led by good demand for product into the East Med following a recent tender into Turkey and a Greek tender for diesel that closes on Wednesday.
Traders said diesel buying for Italy was also supportive.
Diesel cargoes were valued $1-2 firmer at $161-2 cif Med. 0.2 sulphur heating oil prices were also slightly firmer at around $157/$159 a tonne cif Med.

Gasoline in the Mediterranean was viewed as static with premium unleaded cargoes holding around $193/194 cif Med. Traders said expectations of support for the area from Nigerian demand had not been fulfilled.
"I've seen stuff going from the north into West Africa, but little from here," said one Med dealer.
A 30,000-tonne cargo was seen fixed from NWE to West Africa today. Traders said the market was looking to August demand to kick in.
High sulphur was stronger in the Mediterranean with traders saying there was a shortage of bunker spec material. A Spanish refiner said he was ready to pay $82 fob a tonne for bunker spec.
"We tried to buy at $82 in the north but the seller would not do a deal at that level," the refiner said.
An Italian major was heard to be sending three cargoes of 20,000 tonnes each of high sulphur material to Tunisia in exchange for low sulphur straight-run.
However a major buyer of Mediterranean fuel, state utility Electricidade de Portugal, was said to be covered and not planning at the moment to issue tenders for high sulphur fuel.
One percent was quiet, with traders saying that an Italian buyer was absent from the market today.
